# Ontario Thriving Development Program (OTDP)

> OTDP is a student-led non-profit running a free, fully online platform for every student across Ontario, Canada — personalized study plans, study techniques, career-path guidance and a multilingual resource library. No tuition, no entry tests, no catch. Founded 2026.

## About
- Free for every Ontario student — no cost, ever. Funded by partners and donations, not student fees.
- Fully online and automated: there are no human tutors and no in-person sessions. Students get automated study plans, guided walkthroughs, study techniques and career guidance on demand.
- Career-path guidance is automated around each student's desired career and chosen intensity (from casually exploring to all-in), and maps the courses and skills to get there.
- Guides, plans and resources are available in multiple languages.
- Student-led: the people running the organisation come from IB, AP, SHSM, French Immersion, York Arts and mainstream high-school backgrounds.
- Governed by a Board under the 2026 OTDP Constitution.
- Subjects: math, sciences, English, French, social sciences and most Ontario high-school subjects.
- Signature feature: an end-of-semester project linking each subject to a real-world cause, with any funds raised donated to organisations addressing it.

## How to sign up
- Students sign up by email to otdp.org@gmail.com with the subject "Student sign-up — OTDP".
- Every "Sign up" button on the website opens a pre-filled Gmail draft using that template.
- A real person replies (usually within a week) to set students up with access to the platform.
- Schools, community groups and prospective volunteers reach out to the same address.
